snippet.title: Formula One (2020 Edition) Walkthrough (Expert: Drivers & Constructors Championship), ZX Spectrum
snippet.description:
Huge playlist archive with AY / GFX improved games: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLxOanVBhqd3t74YnYAJA9p4vMQYZYCJWX
New version of the all time classic Formula One game. It contains an update for the 2020 Formula 1 season and graphical improvements. This has been updated:

- Year (2020)
- Teams (Red Bull, Ferrari, Mercedes, Williams, McLaren and Renault)
- Scoring System (10 points for winner, so that was in force from 2003 to 2009)
- Sponsors (from the 2020 season)
- Drivers (14 current riders and 10 famous former drivers)
- 2020 Grand Prix (country and circuit)
- Number of laps and length of circuits
- GP winners the previous year
- Records back in running, prior to 2020

Note: By limiting the original game season to 16 Grands Prix, the Sakhir Grand Prix taking place in Bahrain (penultimate GP this year) is not included. Bahrain hosts yet another Grand Prix in the 2020 season.

Some graphical updates have also been made to the game:

- Improvements in the side view of cars
- Mod name at the top of the loading screen
- Improvement in airship hovering in the sky during the race
- Improvements in the top view of cars

Credits:

Formula One mod 2020 was created J. Martins (data update) and Rui Martins (graphical improvements).
Use of Formula One Editor created by BadBeard (available in World of Spectrum), in addition to other tools.

Original 1985 game: Peter Wheelhouse and George Munday

The mod was made available to the ZX Spectrum fan community on the day of the Formula 1 Portuguese Grand Prix (Portimão International Racetrack), to celebrate the return of the competition to Portugal after 24 years.

This is the tribute to one of the best games to appear for spectrum, giving due recognition to its creators, who even have a special connection to Portugal.

Download here: https://www.dropbox.com/s/ql6y48f84r5ll07/FormulaOne-CRL-MOD2020_25-10-2020_v1a.sna?dl=0

                       HOW TO PLAY:

  1 to 6 players each controlling a 1 or 2 car
Formula One team compete in this full simulation
 of a Grand Prix racing season. Before each of
  the 16 races, you must invest you sponsors'
money in improving your drivers, cars and pit crew.

 Your object is to win the Drivers Championship
 or the Constructors Championship . . . . or both!

A full record of each track's history is displayed
      before the race, along with a weather
   forecast helping you to choose your tyres.

    While each race is being run on the screen,
     information is displayed by a constant
   commentary and full scoreboard. Unforeseen
   circumstances, such as crashes and changes
  in weather will mean cars must be called into
   the pits. Each player has to control his own
  crew during these pit stops by using the keys
                             or joystick.

   Instructions are listed on the reverse of the
  inlay card (for a demonstration, press 0 when
          asked the number of players).

       
      CRL Group PLC, CRL House, 9 Kings Yard,
         Carpenters Road, London E15 2HD.


               (c) CRL GROUP 1985


KEY CONTROLS:

To move arrow on team selection and
graph screens...

6-UP     7-DOWN

Pit Stops...

Q-UP Z-DOWN I-LEFT P-RIGHT
N-EXECUTE MANOEUVRE

The following keys only have an affect
when a race is in progress...

P-request pit stop

C-cancel pit stop request

F-full race graphics

H-highlights only

G-gambling option

S-save game
